reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: 24.1 gives Customer a consent-free affiliate/successor (merger, reorganization, acquisition, substantial asset sale) carve-out subject only to prompt notice and assumption.

24.2 restricts Vendor assignment, delegation of material performance and transfer by change of control to Customer's consent (not unreasonably withheld) with a direct-competitor bar; 24.3 supplies a mutual reasonableness-qualified consent standard.
24.4 expressly negates any Vendor right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees or reduce service on Customer's change of control, so no walk-away trigger exists.
No redline or comment was proposed, which is the correct output for a compliant finding; the deterministic check confirming the successor/affiliate carve-out is consistent.
